title: Single governed pilot login and same-origin session
objective: Add the simplest closed-pilot operator sign-in and server session in existing crm-api, reuse existing RequestAuthenticator and governed permissions, without OIDC/JWT/refresh subsystems, extra service or new business module. Public production deployment is separately gated.
deliverables: one configured closed-pilot operator login path in existing crm-api with no password database or SSO provider
same-origin HttpOnly Secure SameSite short session cookie: expire logout revoke and re-login after restart
shared existing RequestAuthenticator remains the sole HTTP and gRPC-web authentication boundary; no frontend actor or tenant authority
production-built browser session snapshot without bootstrap bearer, authorized capabilities and clear sign-in/sign-out states
two test operators and two tenants with denial of cross-tenant queries and mutations through existing gateway and FORCE RLS
negative tests for missing forged expired cookie bad CSRF failed login restart and denied permissions
exact G1 baseline, scoped code changes, deterministic generated packet and CI acceptance without bypass
no new business crates, duplicate authorization system, OIDC/SSO subsystem, or fake production readiness
preserve the accepted Step22H direct-runtime inventory, decisions ledger and remaining Step22R obligations unchanged
update only the exact trusted runtime blob SHA in existing Customer Privacy operations metrics source guard after G1 runtime changed; keep all failure and restore checks intact
acceptance: one operator login server path and minimal session on standard built CRM UI without developer bearer
two test actors two tenants with server-side membership authorization and FORCE RLS, negative access paths
short session expires, revoked on logout, fails closed after server restart and on CSRF or cookie error
HTTP and gRPC-web are both bound to the existing RequestAuthenticator and governed permissions
no new authorization engine, business modules, OIDC integration or public production claim
all changes confined to G1 whitelist; generated navigation deterministic; selected exact-head checks pass and main push checks pass after merging
non_goals: add OAuth/OIDC JWT SSO, separate identity service, multi-provider configuration or refresh-token daemon for a closed test pilot
create a role editor, self registration, password database, business module or CRUD bypass
persistent browser sessions across process restarts or promises of deployment-grade identity
expose the process bootstrap bearer or grant actor tenant choice to the browser
claim public production is authorized without separate deployment/security evidence in #313/#314
alter Step22H ledger, Step22R obligations or architecture 10 of 10 status
